selection_policy.name: validated_research_score_v1
selection_policy.rule: Only existing research checkpoints with a compatible input and locked validation evidence are eligible.

ensemble_policy.rule: An ensemble is enabled only when calibrated member probabilities, weights, and improvement over the active single model are established on a locked evaluation protocol.

models.calibration: Reserved MRNet development calibration subset; not clinically or externally calibrated.

calibration_metrics.status: Not recorded for this existing checkpoint; do not infer calibration quality from this registry.

models.inference_profile: Local PyTorch study-level inference; speed varies by device and number of slices.
models.limitations: MRNet-only training; one-seed development evidence; patient linkage unavailable; not clinically validated.
